complete_examples.text: With special attention of the influence of k 0 sc , z and l lim on system vibrations, Figs. 28 and 29 shows the typical response of wheel-rail force, sleeper-subgrade relative displacement v sd , rail displacement and rail acceleration when a vehicle passes over the “hanging sleeper” portion.

That is because the sleeper will hit the subgrade surface layer and k sc, z becomes non-zero when | v sd | ≥l lim,0 , and gradually the sleeper will be separated from the contact with the subgrade with elasticity, k sc, z becomes zero when | v sd | < l lim,0 , and then hitting again, this process will be repeated until the vehicle passes over the “hanging sleeper” portion and the vibration attenuates to a steady state.
